title.narrative: Institutional Capacity Enhanced for Safeguarding Living Heritage of Pakistan

description.narrative:
Within the framework of the Strategic Cooperation Roadmap (2026-30) finalized in follow up to the high-level meeting of Director General UNESCO with Prime-Minister of Pakistan in February 2026, the proposed intervention will support Federal and Provincial cultural institutions in the effective implementation of the 2003 Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage.
The intervention will build upon previous initiatives, including the national consultation workshop organized during the 2022–2023 biennium, and will support the implementation of the recommendations and priority actions identified through that process. Based on the findings of the consultation and subsequent stakeholder engagements, UNESCO will strengthen the capacities of Provincial Directorates of Culture and the National Institute of Folk and Traditional Heritage (Lok Virsa) to effectively implement the 2003 Convention and benefit from the international cooperation mechanisms established under it.
